name: regulatory-change-impact-agent
description: Regulatory data ingestion server for Regulatory Change Impact Agent

scriptsComments.npm run compare (or npm run status): Comparison: compares live public portal documents against local disk storage, verifies physical presence, and auto-syncs any missing files.
scriptsComments.npm run extract: Extraction: runs the ingestion & extraction engine across all regulatory sources to download and parse circulars.
scriptsComments.npm run dev: Server: starts the Express API server on port 4000 (with background cron scheduler every 15m).
